_comment: The Expanse — OPA / Drift / Free Navy. Grounded 2026-05-28 from show frames (refs/drift/NOTES.md): the brand is ECLECTICISM (salvaged, repurposed gear). DUAL accent — amber/orange + cyan (unlike Mars's single-accent discipline); warm-brown surface tint separates it from the cool MCRN/EARTH themes. Embrace slight grit/noise (Peel: 'because it's junk'). Lang Belta creole label fragments as texture. layout=pack (varied bin-pack reads improvised, not a planned grid). Red = threat/HAMMER-LOK (same escalation role as MarsBlue). 2026-06-07 third-pass desaturation: amber → olive-amber (#b88c45), cyan → muted teal (#5a9a9a) to match the 'old-phosphor' register of bel_pPutN_020 vs the prior fluorescent neon. status warning/danger stay vivid (rare signal).

data._comment: Dual warm+cool ladder — desaturated to old-phosphor register per bel_pPutN_020 (muted teal lead + olive-amber). System amber[4]/red[5] stay vivid as rare signals.
